# `⍷` — Find

Keys: `Alt-Minus e`

`X⍷Y` marks starting positions where the whole pattern `X` occurs in `Y`. The result has `Y`'s shape. Overlaps count.

```bpl
"ana"⍷"banana"      ⍝ $f $t $f $t $f $f
1 1⍷1 1 1          ⍝ $t $t $f
```

Works with multidimensional patterns and tolerant element matching.
